aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds software for food trucks and mobile catering: online ordering, pickup times, fewer repeated questions. Founder — Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for food truck and mobile catering businesses: they take online orders, manage pickup times, keep the flow of orders smooth and spend less time on repeated questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change this.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet most of the software available to them is designed for businesses with a permanent address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our aim is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools built to fit how these businesses really work.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab began with a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their business.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After I created Village Foodie, a directory that helps people find food trucks coming to their area, I started learning more about the difficulties mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are always on the move, work in different places and serve customers in changing conditions.

comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see collection times your kitchen can really manage. The system works from each dish's preparation time and how many you prepare at once.

comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Online card payments also carry Stripe commissions: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.costTrial: {months, plural, one {The first month is} other {The first # months are}} free with all features.
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set up your weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for the place and day you are there.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does the system work with changing locations?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay at the food truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported for now.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is neither a minimum term nor a notice period. You can cancel at any time; the payment is taken monthly in advance, and access remains until the end of the paid month.

comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a till and has no TSE. How to record online orders in your till is a matter to settle with your tax adviser.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a till with a TSE module?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers come to the food truck: they choose dishes and a collection time, pay online or on collection, and the order appears in your kitchen. A till or payment terminal, by contrast, takes payment at the food truck. The two complement each other.

featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, taxes and refunds for any month, quarter or tax year — ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm each one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to your QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: When you give a customer a buzzer, attach its number to the order — you know which device belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers see: order numbers and when they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the public HatchGrab map — nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your certificates in one place: food hygiene, insurance, gas safety and others. We remind you before they expire, and you can send them to an event or market organiser in one tap.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each one leads straight to its own ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create event types with their own prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The fullest way to work with HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen, and also the only way to keep taking orders when the signal drops.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook at one time and how long it takes. Once a time slot is full, customers cannot choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward regular customers with digital stamp cards — stamps are collected and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine dishes into combo deals and offer extras at checkout to raise the average order.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Like WhatsApp auto-replies, but for Messenger and Instagram enquiries.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — at the counter and in the kitchen — all showing the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff separate logins with the right level of permission.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If the signal drops, online ordering pauses — customers cannot place orders you won’t see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app lets you take orders in offline mode too; the web dashboard, however, needs an internet connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: When customers order online, take card payment upfront via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set the last time orders are accepted for dishes that need advance preparation.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t appear on the map — they get their own separate private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Enter the cost of each dish and see your real profit at every event, not just the takings.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A print-ready QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill your schedule automatically — from your website or from a picture you already post to your Facebook page. You only review and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Customers are sent an SMS automatically when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically add the dates, places and times for each week and event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any dish “sold out” in one tap — it turns grey for customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock quantity — it goes down as orders come in, then the dish is automatically marked “sold out”.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a compatible phone — no separate card terminal needed.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a time slot as their pickup time — demand is spread evenly across the service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the serving window — payment through your own card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from the browser of any phone, tablet or laptop.

landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the food truck — and on the card terminal you already take payments on.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a permanent address, stable Wi-Fi and the same working hours every week. But you work in a new place every week, at different times, where mobile coverage is weak or absent. HatchGrab was built for exactly these conditions.
landing.does.offlineBody: If the signal drops, online ordering pauses automatically — customers cannot place orders you won’t see. Keep taking orders through the iPhone, iPad and Android app.

landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a pickup time. Queues get shorter, and the food is ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Built not for restaurants, but for food trucks.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you this evening?” “What desserts do you have?” While you are driving to the trading spot or standing at the barbecue grill, your WhatsApp messages are answered based on your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram will be added soon.
